payload.summary: Refined plan-roadmap's generic scaffold into a concrete, testable design: split decide_intent's routing logic (_route, pure) from acquisition (always-fallback in this item), specified the caller-supplied event_sink contract, wrote real TDD tasks with checkpoints, concrete WHEN/THEN scenarios per requirement, a contracts/README.md stub, and a schema-valid coordinated-tier work-packages.yaml with a real verification step.
completed_work: Rewrote tasks.md with TDD-ordered, single-commit-sized tasks and checkpoint markers
Rewrote specs/system-one-decisions/spec.md with concrete mechanism-level WHEN/THEN scenarios
Added design.md decisions D1-D4 and answered the scaffold's open questions
Added contracts/README.md (no contracts applicable) and a schema-valid work-packages.yaml with a real verification step
Added an Approaches Considered section to proposal.md with three approaches and a recorded selection

decisions.title: Split _route (pure) from decide_intent (always-fallback in this item)
decisions.rationale: The four documented checks must be unit-testable with zero network calls; factoring out pure routing logic makes that possible without contradicting 'no network call at all'.

decisions.title: event_sink is a caller-supplied callable, not an autopilot import
decisions.rationale: Preserves the package-boundary reason this item exists — gen-eval and the coordinator image cannot import skills/autopilot.

decisions.title: Renamed the spec delta directory to system-one-decisions
decisions.rationale: The scaffolded directory name was the roadmap workspace name, a placeholder; the real capability is the package itself.
